seo_desc: Christmas events for kids around Minnetonka and Lake Minnetonka for 2026: Santa and Grinch train rides at Everly Farms, Christmas in Excelsior and more.
lede: Minnetonka and the Lake Minnetonka towns do Christmas with a farm train, a lakeside village weekend and library events for little ones.
celebrates: Families around Lake Minnetonka mix farm and village traditions. At Everly Farms in Minnetrista, the Everly Express holiday train carries guests to Santa's barn and the Grinch on weekends through December 19. Downtown Excelsior hosts Christmas in Excelsior with a holiday market, live reindeer, roaming carolers, Santa, horse-drawn carriage rides and festive food, according to the Excelsior-Lake Minnetonka Chamber. Minnetonka's own offerings include a Noon Year's Eve party for kids and a holiday open house at Goldfish Swim School.
lastyear: Everly Farms describes itself as a former orchard that began as Minnetonka Orchard in 1976 and now runs a winery, restaurant and seasonal events across 43 acres. Its Christmas page for 2026 lists Santa visits, Grinch visits, fresh-cut Christmas trees and a Gift Barn, which suggests the holiday program has grown into a regular part of the farm's year. Excelsior's chamber lists a calendar of themed Saturdays from late November through December 19.
facts: Everly Farms in Minnetrista says its land has been a gathering place for nearly 50 years, since it opened as Minnetonka Orchard in 1976. The farm's holiday train is called the Everly Express. Excelsior's chamber promotes Christmas in Excelsior as a holiday market with live reindeer, carolers and Santa, and the chamber lists free photos with Santa with hot chocolate, cider and cookies on several December Saturdays.
trains: The Everly Express holiday train at Everly Farms in Minnetrista is the closest train ride we could verify to Minnetonka. Farther in, the Minnesota Streetcar Museum runs the Holly Trolley in Minneapolis and the Twin City Model Railroad Museum in Saint Paul hosts Night Trains with Santa. CPKC's Holiday Train stops in St. Louis Park and Golden Valley on December 14, according to CPKC and the city of St. Louis Park.

faq: Families around Lake Minnetonka head to Everly Farms for Santa and Grinch train rides, to Excelsior for Christmas in Excelsior and to Minnetonka for kids' events such as Noon Year's Eve.
Is there a Christmas train near Minnetonka?
Everly Farms in Minnetrista runs the Everly Express holiday train for Santa and Grinch visits on weekends through December 19. Tickets are sold on the farm's event page.
Where can kids see live reindeer?
The Excelsior-Lake Minnetonka Chamber lists live reindeer at Christmas in Excelsior.
Can I visit Santa for free near Lake Minnetonka?
The chamber lists free photos with Santa at the Excelsior Masonic Lodge on December Saturdays, with hot chocolate, cider and cookies, according to a local roundup of the chamber's schedule.

intro_html:
Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in Minnetonka for 2026, and here is what he found: 6 family events across Minnetonka, Excelsior and Minnetrista, none confirmed free. The magic runs from November 20 (Meet Santa at Ridgedale Center) through January 10, 2027 (the Black Family Light Show), with Santa and Grinch train rides at Everly Farms (weekends through December 19), Christmas in Excelsior (November 27 and 28) and Noon Year's Eve (December 31) along the way. We check every date on the host's own website, and each listing links straight there.
